target.title: fix(plugins): hide bundle commands when frontmatter uses on
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users shipping bundled Claude commands could set `disable-model-invocation: on` in command frontmatter and still have that command remain available for model invocation.

## Why This Change Was Made

The bundle command loader now reuses the shared frontmatter boolean parser instead of maintaining a narrower local parser. This keeps the owner-local command-loading path aligned with the existing frontmatter contract without adding config, compatibility aliases, or broader plugin behavior changes.

## User Impact

Bundle authors can use common boolean frontmatter values consistently: `on`, `yes`, and `1` disable model invocation, while `off`, `no`, and `0` leave commands available.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: bundle command loading excludes commands marked with `disable-model-invocation: on`, `yes`, and `1`, while preserving commands marked with `off`, `no`, and `0`.
- Current-head proof at `4c493488d6642643a32103d79edce3232a9fcbe8`: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/plugins/bundle-commands.test.ts` passed with 1 test file and 1 test.
- Real temporary bundle proof at `4c493488d6642643a32103d79edce3232a9fcbe8`: `node --import tsx --input-type=module -` created a temporary Claude bundle with `plugins.load.paths` pointed at that bundle root, wrote `commands/disabled-on.md` and `commands/enabled-off.md`, then called the production `loadEnabledClaudeBundleCommands` path.

  ```json
  {
    "head": "4c493488d6642643a32103d79edce3232a9fcbe8",
    "loadedCommandNames": ["enabled-off"],
    "disabledOnPresent": false,
    "enabledOffPresent": true,
    "enabledOffSourceEndsWith": true,
    "commandCount": 1
  }
  ```

- PR diff hygiene: `git diff --check 4a675228af5758d6205b7d8a058f2a1d42948721...HEAD` passed.
- Exact-head GitHub checks at `4c493488d6642643a32103d79edce3232a9fcbe8`: `check-test-types`, `openclaw/ci-gate`, and the rest of the PR check rollup passed.
- Observed result: in the real temporary bundle proof, the final model-facing command list excludes the `on` command and retains the `off` command.
